[[File:Cabaret-DoM.png|thumb|right|200px|Cabaret]]
A '''cabaret''' was a type of establishment on the [[Planet/Legends|planets]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]<ref name="LL">{{TCW|Lightsaber Lost}}</ref> and [[Bonadan/Legends|Bonadan]].<ref name="GSWU">''[[A Guide to the Star Wars Universe]]'', under "Alien Quarter"</ref> On Coruscant, one cabaret's façade showed a picture of a kneeling [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]]<ref name="DM" /> [[Gender/Legends|woman]],<ref name="Trivia">{{SW|url=series/clone-wars/lethal-trackdown-trivia-gallery|text="Lethal Trackdown" Trivia Gallery|quote=The nightclub on Coruscant is filled with posters of various female pin-up models}} {{C|Slide 6}}</ref> dressed in a revealing, [[Color/Legends|purple]] [[Clothing/Legends|outfit]]. The picture was also put up in public places in order to promote the establishments.<ref name="DM">{{TCW|Duchess of Mandalore}}</ref> To promote the establishment, the picture was also put up as a [[Cabaret poster/Legends|series of posters]] in public places.<ref name="Duchess of Mandalore">{{TCW|Duchess of Mandalore}}</ref> A differently [[Color/Legends|colored]] version of the poster was put up in [[Moshi Bar/Legends|Moshi Bar]].<ref name="Lethal Trackdown">{{TCW|Lethal Trackdown}}</ref> On Bonadan, cabarets were located in the [[Bonadan Alien Quarter|Alien Quarter]].<ref name="GSWU" />
